import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long flow, capacity;

        Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long capacity) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAX_SIZE];
        int s, t;
        int[] dist = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] visited = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] cur = new int[MAX_SIZE];

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MaxFlow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void init() {
            edges.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                graph[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, long capacity) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(from, to, 0, capacity);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(to, from, 0, 0);
            edges.add(e1);
            edges.add(e2);
            int idx = edges.size() - 2;
            graph[from].add(idx);
            graph[to].add(idx + 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            visited[s] = 1;
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i : graph[v]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    int nxt = e.to;
                    if (visited[nxt] == 0 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                        dist[nxt] = dist[v] + 1;
                        q.offer(nxt);
                        visited[nxt] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visited[t] == 1;
        }

        long dfs(int x, long cp) {
            if (x == t || cp == 0) return cp;
            long flow = 0, newFlow;
            for (int &y = cur[x]; y < graph[x].size(); y++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(graph[x].get(y));
                if (dist[x] + 1 == dist[e.to]) {
                    long minCap = Math.min(cp, e.capacity - e.flow);
                    newFlow = dfs(e.to, minCap);
                    if (newFlow > 0) {
                        edges.get(graph[x].get(y)).flow += newFlow;
                        edges.get(graph[x].get(y) ^ 1).flow -= newFlow;
                        flow += newFlow;
                        cp -= newFlow;
                        if (cp == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long dinic() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                flow += dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n;
    static char[][] g1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] dist = new int[14][14];
    static int[] tgt = new int[103];

    static int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

    static void BFS(int x, int y, int maxN) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y, 0});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int px = p[0], py = p[1], pDist = p[2];
            if (visited[px][py]) continue;
            visited[px][py] = true;
            dist[px][py] = pDist;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tx = px + dx[i], ty = py + dy[i];
                if (tx <= 0 || tx > maxN || ty <= 0 || ty > maxN) continue;
                if (visited[tx][ty] || g1[tx][ty] == 'Y') continue;
                q.offer(new int[]{tx, ty, pDist + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    static int index(int level, int x, int y, int n) {
        return level * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            g1[i] = (" " + br.readLine()).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            g2[i] = (" " + br.readLine()).toCharArray();
        }

        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow();
        mf.s = 0;
        mf.t = MAX_SIZE - 2;

        int x = 0, y = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; i++) {
            tgt[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (n * n - i);
        }

        BFS(x, y, n);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(mf.s, index(0, i, j, n), g1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(tgt[index(0, i, j, n)], mf.t, g2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                mf.addEdge(index(0, i, j, n), tgt[index(0, i, j, n)], INF);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = j + dx[l], ty = k + dy[l];
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (dist[j][k] >= i && dist[tx][ty] >= i) {
                                mf.addEdge(index(i - 1, tx, ty, n), index(i, j, k, n), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.addEdge(index(i, j, k, n), tgt[index(0, j, k, n)], INF);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.dinic());
    }
}
